literal: The lord of the shore's departure, will they not proclaim, the bangles that are slipping down from the wrist of my forearm?
translation: Will not the bangles, slipping down from the wrists of my forearms, proclaim to the world that the lord of the shore has departed?
modern: முன்கையின் மணிக்கட்டிலிருந்து கழன்று விழுகின்ற வளையல்கள், நெய்தல் நிலத் தலைவன் என்னை விட்டுப் பிரிந்து சென்றதை ஊராருக்கு வெளிப்படுத்திக் காட்டாவோ?
explanation: The heroine is deeply distressed by the separation of her lover, the lord of the maritime tract (துறைவன்). Her intense grief and pining cause her body to waste away, making her arms grow thin. Consequently, the bangles on her wrists begin to slip off. She laments that even if she tries to hide her sorrow, these slipping bangles will loudly proclaim his departure to the entire neighborhood.
